prompt.title: A tasting test
prompt.passage:
It is a food festival. Amy and Jenny are hungry.
There is a tasting test. Amy tastes congee. She likes it.
Jenny tastes noodles. Then there is no food.
A little dog brings a clue. Amy and Jenny find the last dish. It is Pen Cai.
Amy and Jenny are the winners. They choose dim sum and baozi.
